summary.text:
Promoting Reentry through Education in Prisons Act of 2026 or the PREP Act
This bill expands educational opportunities for individuals who are incarcerated in federal and state correctional facilities.
Specifically, the bill creates an Office of Prison Education within the Bureau of Prisons (BOP). Under the bill, the office must establish and implement a Federal Prison Education Program to provide quality educational services to individuals who are incarcerated in federal correctional facilities. The office must also establish and maintain a clearinghouse for research, policies, and best practices on quality education programs in prison.
Additionally, the bill requires the office to provide training and technical assistance to state correctional institutions on developing and implementing policies and procedures for quality education programs in prison.
Finally, the bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs, in coordination with BOP and state correctional agencies, to conduct outreach to incarcerated veterans about potential eligibility for educational assistance and connect veterans to quality education programs in prison.
